نستمتع (form X)
# نَسْتَمْتِعُ (nastamtiʕu) /nas.tam.ti.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمْتَعَ (istamtaʕa)
# نَسْتَمْتِعَ (nastamtiʕa) /nas.tam.ti.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَمْتَعَ (istamtaʕa)
# نَسْتَمْتِعْ (nastamtiʕ) /nas.tam.tiʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَمْتَعَ (istamtaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
